judgments.supporting_quote: In case of dry running, pump bearing and shaft seal will be damaged; vibrations indicating imminent bearing failure
Operation of the pump under conditions differing widely from those, on which the pump selection was based, may result in cavitation or shortened life of bearings, seals, packing, and shaft.
Insufficient inlet pressure will cause the pump to cavitate leading to low performance, noise and short pump life.
